continuity: Choi Minwoo and most of Jin Taekyung’s allies are secretly trying to keep him in Cheon Taemin’s Pentagon recovery chamber until Morgoth’s three-day deadline expires; Chuck Hagel and the Skeleton King were not told.
Jin Taekyung has avoided visiting his mother, younger sister, Song Song, and Im Kkeokjeong because he fears their involvement in the coming battle would get them killed.
Jin believes Cheon Taemin was the Martial God and The Helper, and that Asmodeus may not have been completely erased; these remain Jin’s conclusions, not confirmed facts.
plot: At the Pentagon, Jin Taekyung visits the unconscious Cheon Taemin and confronts his suspicion that Taemin was the Martial God and The Helper, and that Asmodeus may not have been completely erased. Choi Minwoo admits that he and most of their allies have secretly arranged to keep Jin confined until Morgoth’s three-day deadline expires, fearing Jin will confront Morgoth alone. Jin recognizes that Choi’s grandfather may have kept Choi at a distance because of a danger he sensed, and reveals that he has avoided his own family and guildmates to protect them from the coming battle. When Jin attempts to leave, he discovers the exit has vanished. Choi warns that breaking the protective spells could destroy the Pentagon; Jin uses his ability to see a seam in the mana binding the spells and splits it.
translation_decisions: Keep Jin’s identification of Cheon Taemin as the Martial God and The Helper framed as his belief; the chapter supplies no independent confirmation.
Render the chapter’s use of 결 as “seam” for the visible line in the mana binding the protective spells.

active_continuity: Morgoth’s three-day deadline is still running; his demand for Cheon Taemin and Jin Taekyung as tribute remains in effect.
Cheon Taemin remains unconscious in a recovery capsule in a hidden Pentagon chamber.
Jin believes Cheon Taemin was the Martial God and The Helper, and suspects Asmodeus was not completely erased; these identities and suspicions are unconfirmed.
Choi Minwoo and most allies are secretly keeping Jin in the chamber until Morgoth’s deadline expires; Chuck Hagel and the Skeleton King were excluded from the plan.
Jin has avoided his family and guildmates, fearing they would die if drawn into the coming battle.
open_questions: Were Cheon Taemin, the Martial God, and The Helper the same person?
Can Jin break out of the chamber without bringing down the Pentagon?
What will happen when Morgoth’s three-day deadline expires?
